title.rendered: Labour Colony in Greater Noida — Factory-Direct Worker Housing

content.rendered:
Building a labour colony in Greater Noida for your factory, warehouse, or EPC site? SAMAN Portable supplies prefabricated worker housing that is manufactured at our own Jalpura, Greater Noida 201308 factory — the same district as your project. This proximity means short-haul dispatch, faster installation, and direct manufacturer support, with no middleman markup.

Our prefab labour accommodation uses an IS 2062 MS steel frame with insulated PUF wall and roof panels, giving you durable, weather-ready worker camps that can be deployed quickly near your construction zone while meeting site welfare requirements. Serving India since 2009, incorporated as SAMAN POS India Private Limited in 2019, we build to order — ground-only or G+1, 16 rooms or more.

Need Worker Housing in Greater Noida?

Tell us your site, worker count, and timeline. We dispatch from our Jalpura, Greater Noida 201308 factory and install across the district.

Call +91 62009 09435 Send Enquiry

Factory-Direct From Jalpura, Greater Noida 201308

Most labour colony suppliers you find online are traders or directory listings shipping units in from another city. SAMAN Portable is a direct manufacturer, and our North-India unit sits inside Greater Noida itself at Jalpura 201308. For a Greater Noida project, that is the strongest practical advantage we can offer:

  • Same-district dispatch — units travel a short distance from factory to your site, reducing transport time and handling.
  • Direct factory pricing — you buy from the maker, not a reseller, so the quote reflects the real build cost.
  • On-site installation by our own teams — supply, assembly, and handover are handled together, not subcontracted blind.
  • After-sales reach — being in the district makes support and any service visit straightforward.

We back every structure with 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. We are an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer with 500+ projects delivered across India, and accommodation can be returned within 7 days of delivery or installation if it does not match the agreed specification.

Worker Housing for Factories, Warehouses, and EPC Sites

Greater Noida's industrial corridors run on a large on-site workforce, and a well-built labour colony keeps that workforce close, rested, and compliant. Our prefab worker camps are configured for the three site types we supply most:

Manufacturing Facilities

  • Shift-friendly layouts with multiple entry and exit points
  • Insulated panels that keep rooms comfortable for round-the-clock occupancy
  • Reinforced electrical provisioning for higher-load areas
  • Scalable blocks that grow with production capacity

Warehouse Complexes

  • Space-efficient layouts that minimise land use
  • Modular expansion for seasonal workforce swings
  • Secure perimeter and controlled-access options
  • Common areas for logistics-team coordination

EPC Project Sites

  • Rapid deployment for time-bound projects
  • Relocatable blocks that follow construction phases
  • Reinforced structures for tougher site conditions
  • Combined site-office and worker-housing options

Whichever applies, the build is the same proven prefab system — we simply tune the layout, capacity, and amenities to your site. Explore the full prefabricated labour colony range to see the configurations we manufacture.

IS 2062 MS Frame, PUF Panels, and MS Safety Railings

Durability in a working industrial environment comes down to material quality. We build with industrial-grade components throughout:

Insulated PUF Panels

  • 40–50 mm panel thickness for thermal insulation
  • Fire-retardant, moisture-resistant composition
  • Sealed joining system that limits thermal bridging
  • Keeps interiors cooler in summer and warmer in winter

IS 2062 MS Steel Frame

  • Structural MS frame to the IS 2062 steel standard
  • Hot-dipped galvanised protection against corrosion
  • Tubular sections sized for proper load distribution
  • Modular design that allows future expansion

MS Safety Railings

  • Railings at safe height for elevated walkways
  • Powder-coated finish for corrosion protection
  • Anti-slip surface treatment on walkways
  • Reinforced mounting points for G+1 levels

The combination is engineered for Greater Noida's climate: PUF insulation softens summer heat, the galvanised IS 2062 frame resists monsoon humidity without degrading, and sealed panel joints reduce dust ingress and cleaning effort.

Environmental Factor Material Response Benefit
High summer temperatures PUF panel thermal insulation Noticeably cooler interiors than outside
Monsoon humidity and rainfall Galvanised IS 2062 MS frame Structural integrity maintained without rust degradation
Industrial dust and particulates Sealed panel joints and protective finishes Lower maintenance and cleaning effort
Seasonal temperature swings Expansion-tolerant connections No panel separation or structural stress over time

Custom Layouts: 16-Room Ground or G+1 Setup

Our most-requested module is the 16-room labour colony, available ground-only or as a G+1 (ground plus one) to double capacity on the same footprint. Both build on the same prefab system and can be tailored to your plot and worker count.

Ground-Only Configuration

Best for:

  • Sites with ample land available
  • Projects needing the fastest deployment
  • Operations expecting layout changes
  • Soil conditions less suited to multi-level builds

Key features:

  • Linear or back-to-back room arrangements
  • Centralised or distributed sanitation
  • Minimal foundation requirements
  • Easier future relocation or reconfiguration

G+1 Configuration

Best for:

  • Space-constrained industrial plots
  • Higher-density worker accommodation
  • Longer-term project deployments
  • Sites with premium land values

Key features:

  • Double capacity within the same footprint
  • Reinforced foundation system
  • Wide, well-lit staircases
  • Walkways with MS safety railings

Customisation Options

Room Specifications

  • Standard 10' x 10' rooms (2–4 workers)
  • Supervisor rooms 10' x 12'
  • Family quarters 12' x 12' with partitions
  • Custom ceiling heights from standard 8'6"

Facility Add-Ons

  • Kitchen and dining areas
  • Recreation rooms
  • Laundry sections with washing points
  • Storage rooms and basic medical-aid room

Security Features

  • Guard room at the entrance
  • Perimeter fencing options
  • Common-area lighting
  • CCTV provision points and controlled access

Each layout is finalised with you so it fits your operational needs and complies with worker-housing welfare requirements for industrial sites.

Hygiene Facilities: Toilets, Washing, and Common Areas

Sanitation is a core part of a compliant labour colony, not an afterthought. Our worker camps include proper toilet, washing, and common-area provisions, along with water supply and waste handling.

Toilet Facilities

  • Separate male and female sections with privacy partitions
  • Durable ceramic fixtures with efficient flushing
  • Anti-skid flooring with proper drainage slopes
  • Ventilation to prevent odour build-up

Washing Areas

  • Multiple washing stations with water-efficient taps
  • Drainage that prevents water pooling
  • Shelving for personal hygiene items
  • Adequate lighting for all-hours use

Common Areas

  • Covered, ventilated gathering spaces
  • Seating for meals and rest
  • Food-preparation areas where required
  • Waste-segregation and collection points

Water Supply

  • Overhead storage tanks sized to colony capacity
  • Distribution piping with pressure management
  • Connection points for municipal or tanker supply
  • Separate drinking-water provision where required

Waste Management

  • Properly sized septic tanks where sewerage is absent
  • Connection provisions for municipal sewage
  • Grease traps for kitchen waste where applicable
  • Stormwater drainage systems

How We Supply Your Greater Noida Project

From first call to handover, the process is straightforward and handled directly by us:

  1. Consultation — we discuss your site, worker count, and timeline.
  2. Site assessment — we evaluate the location to fix the optimal configuration.
  3. Proposal — you receive a quotation with layout plans and specifications.
  4. Manufacturing — on approval, your units are built at our Jalpura, Greater Noida 201308 factory.
  5. Installation — our own team assembles on site.
  6. Handover — we provide documentation and usage guidelines.

For full product specifications and capacity options, see our labour colony product details. To move ahead, share your site location, worker count, preferred configuration (ground-only or G+1), and project timeline.

Dispatched from our Jalpura, Greater Noida 201308 factory, installed by our own team. Open Mon–Sat, 9:00 AM–8:00 PM.

Call +91 62009 09435 Send Enquiry

FAQs: Labour Colony in Greater Noida


Where do you dispatch labour colonies for Greater Noida from?

We dispatch from our own factory at Jalpura, Greater Noida 201308 — the same district as your site. This keeps transport short and lets our own team handle installation directly.


How much does a labour colony in Greater Noida cost?

Pricing is quote-based, because it depends on room count, ground-only versus G+1, amenities, and site conditions. Share your worker count and configuration and we will prepare a detailed quotation.


Do you handle installation, or just supply the units?

We do both. As a direct manufacturer with a Greater Noida factory, we supply, deliver, and install with our own team, then hand over with documentation and usage guidelines.


What warranty do you provide?

Every structure carries 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the build, not a warranty period.


How many workers can the standard layout house?

Our most-requested module is a 16-room layout, with standard 10' x 10' rooms taking 2–4 workers each. We build ground-only or G+1 to double capacity on the same footprint, and scale up or add amenity blocks to match your numbers.


What materials are used in the structure?

An IS 2062 MS steel frame with hot-dipped galvanised protection, insulated PUF wall and roof panels (40–50 mm), and MS safety railings on elevated walkways. We are ISO 9001:2015 certified.
